companyFaqDesc.answers: Yes, we welcome sample order to test and check quality. Mixed samples are acceptable.
companyFaqDesc.question: Can I have a sample order for Terminal blocks?

companyFaqDesc.answers: Sample needs 1-2 days, mass production time needs 1-2 weeks for order quantity more than 100K pieces
companyFaqDesc.question: What about the lead time?

companyFaqDesc.answers: For regular products, we keep them in stock. We can meet the quickest shipment according to customers requirement
companyFaqDesc.question: About the delivery time
Do you offer guarantee for the products?

companyFaqDesc.answers:
The payment terms can be flexiable depend on the quantity and products. We firstly prefer Trade Assurance on alibaba,Another, new customer we prefer the 100% T/T before shipping or 30%T/T advance before

producing large quantity.
companyFaqDesc.question: About the payment?

companyFaqDesc.answers: We usually ship by DHL, UPS, FedEx or TNT. It usually takes 3-5 days to arrive. Airline and sea shipping also optional.
